seo.title: Motaqaed | Comprehensive Platform for Retirees
seo.description: Motaqaed is a dedicated digital platform designed to support retired individuals by connecting them with essential services and premium providers.
seo.keywords: motaqaed, retirees platform, senior services, retirement support, healthcare for seniors

project.title: Motaqaed
project.shortDesc: A specialized service bridge connecting retirees with a curated ecosystem of providers and social benefits.

overview.about: Motaqaed is a social-centric platform re-imagining life after retirement. It serves as a comprehensive hub where seniors can access healthcare, financial advisory, and leisure services specifically tailored to their needs, all provided by trusted partners.
overview.goal: To enhance the quality of life for retirees by simplifying access to essential services and fostering a supportive digital community.
overview.audience: Retired professionals, senior citizens, and service providers catering to the needs of the elderly.

challenge.description: Designing for seniors required a unique approach to accessibility and intuitive UI. The challenge was to integrate diverse service providers into a unified, easy-to-use interface that doesn't overwhelm the user.

solution.description: We built a high-accessibility web portal featuring large typography, high-contrast modes, and a simplified navigation structure. The backend includes a robust provider management system and secure payout integrations.
solution.approach: Human-centric design focused on the specific digital habits and needs of the retired community.

features.title: Service Marketplace
features.desc: Browse and book healthcare, legal, and lifestyle services from verified providers.

features.title: Privilege Card
features.desc: Digital membership card offering exclusive discounts and priority access.

features.title: Community Hub
features.desc: Social forums and event calendars focused on senior engagement and networking.

features.title: Health Tracker
features.desc: Integrated health monitoring and appointment reminders for peace of mind.

design.philosophy: Empathic, clear, and reassuring. Focus on high readability, large touch targets, and a calming color palette.

results.impact: Onboarded 500+ service providers and served over 10,000 retirees in the first quarter.

strategy.title: Community Driven
strategy.desc: Creating a digital ecosystem that honors and serves those who have served society.

steps.title: User Inclusivity
steps.desc: Testing with actual retirees to ensure ease of use.

steps.title: Provider Curation
steps.desc: Strict vetting for all listed service providers.

typography.label: // Accessibility
typography.quote: Design is not just what it looks like; it's how it empowers.

compatibility.title: Cross-Device Access
compatibility.desc: Fully optimized for tablets (preferred by seniors) and desktops, with a simplified mobile version for on-the-go service tracking.
